facts.fact: Dr. Luciano Hounkponou is named as President of Benin's Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP) and represented Benin at the 48th Global Privacy Assembly in Brussels, 16-19 November 2026.
Benin's Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP) has a sitting president, Dr. Luciano Hounkponou, who spoke for Benin at the 48th Global Privacy Assembly in November 2026.
